scope: Current admin/configuration/new-features/release-specific and architecture/deployment documentation searches for all 12 mandatory targets; primary lessons selected from official Fortinet feature/admin documentation.

results.configuration_guide: FortiOS 8.0.0 CLI reference and system-global configuration
results.architecture_deployment: FortiOS deployment and networking guidance searched
results.primary_feature: TCP congestion control enhancement with BBR
results.details: Global config system global set tcp-congestion-control {bbr|cubic}; CUBIC remains default; BBR uses bottleneck bandwidth and RTT model.

results.architecture_deployment: FortiSASE Unified-SASE multitenancy architecture guide reviewed for OU/tenant boundaries
results.details: Multiple SASE instances become separate managed devices; same FortiCare account or same OU/sub-OU; FortiManager Key required for different account within same OU.
FDTxxxxxx device, SIEM Xlog files, Log Browse raw visibility, siemdb insertion, default Issue-only handler, custom handlers for Risk Record and Integration Event.

results.configuration_guide: FortiSwitchOS 8.0.0 CLI reference and FortiLink guide
results.new_features_guide: FortiSwitchOS 8.0.0 What's New and zero-touch management
results.details: Auto-network enabled by default since 7.2; peer links become LACP-active ISL; mgmt-vlan is native; DHCP snooping trusted; STP edge disabled; don't reuse mgmt-vlan as an SVI.
Local re-authentication of previously authenticated clients; cache interval 3600-864000 seconds; PEAP credential-hash attribute; global RADIUS CA/server certificates.

results.configuration_guide: Device Properties, Network Device and Resync Interfaces
results.architecture_deployment: FortiNAC inventory/polling and device-model guidance searched
results.primary_feature: Preserve Port Names and interface-model reconciliation
results.details: Global or per-device Preserve Port Names setting; display name uses switch name, ifName and ifDescription; Resync Interfaces updates status and may re-index/recreate models after chassis/stack changes.

results.current_admin_guide: FortiNAC-F 7.6.0 Administration Guide plus 7.6.7 RADIUS-only Device Guide
results.configuration_guide: 7.6.7 selector-based configuration and RADIUS-only migration guide
results.architecture_deployment: FortiNAC-F deployment and RADIUS-only architecture guide
results.details: Only FortiNAC 7.6.7+; no SNMP/CLI required; reusable config objects and ordered selectors; state-based access-control rules.

results.configuration_guide: Subscription VM license configuration and CLI diagnostics
results.architecture_deployment: VM and HA subscription license guidance reviewed
results.details: Requires 8.0.0+ and TCP/443 to update.fortiguard.net; 30 days without validation disables license; authentication stops but admin GUI remains; separate subscription license per HA node.

results.configuration_guide: Creating a policy, creating a secret and launching a secret
results.architecture_deployment: Secret folder/policy inheritance and launcher path reviewed
results.details: Additional authentication independent of login; policy-level and per-secret control; server selection; 0-180 minute duration; remote RADIUS/LDAP users can authenticate with PAM login credentials.

results.configuration_guide: Incidents List View and Analytics Investigation
results.details: Undirected incident/entity graph, Force/Bipartite layout, recursive related entities/incidents, timeline playback, CMDB/context and action history.

results.configuration_guide: Authenticated onboarding Entra ID SAML SP configuration
results.architecture_deployment: FortiSASE Architecture and Unified-SASE multitenancy guides searched
results.details: Select-availability feature, FortiCare enablement; FortiSASE Management is SAML SP; invitation-code rotation and endpoint migration; Entra assertion group cap of 150.

results.configuration_guide: Advanced SD-WAN configuration, IPsec phase1 and BGP CLI references
results.new_features_guide: FortiOS 8.0.0 SD-WAN new features and IPv6 segmentation
results.architecture_deployment: FortiOS SD-WAN best practices and advanced configuration guides
results.primary_feature: IPv6 segmentation over a single SD-WAN/ADVPN overlay
results.details: VPN-ID/IPIP encapsulation carries VRF identity; IPv6 loopback exchange and BGP route separation; VRF-aware SD-WAN health checks; forwarding only, not local-out.

limitations: Some Fortinet documentation pages returned access restrictions when opened directly; official indexed documentation text and official Fortinet PDFs were used where available.
The 12 selected primary sources are official feature, administration, configuration or release-specific documentation; Community sources are scenario-only.
Architecture/deployment guides were searched for all targets; not every product has a separate architecture guide for the selected feature.
